help: Every node is one step of the render. Drag from a node's right edge onto another node's input to rewire it; select a node to edit it in Details.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {id}?
confirmDelete.message: The node goes, and so does every connection to it. There is no undo, and nothing in the canvas can add a node back.

wiring.cycle: That would loop back into itself
